The scarf has fringed edges and can be worn in a classic manner, wrapped around the neck, or simply draped over the shoulders.

paragraphs: The DIOR AND RIMOWA carry-on suitcase is an essential companion for the frequent traveler. The very durable ultralightweight aluminum case is printed with a vintage effect created by a process of aluminum anodizing. The retractable handle and its four wheels ensure effortless travel. The style is fastened by two TSA-approved locks and can be carried vertically or horizontally. The Dior Oblique motif instantly stands out and lends an iconic finishing touch.
